patches.reason: currentTime holds a Date here but a number of seconds elsewhere, so its milliseconds (currentTime.time) do not convert. The live-player check and the saved live time use the legacy getTime(), the Unix seconds that currentTime.time / 1000 gave, in whole seconds.

The stream and news URLs were checked by opening a network connection to them (new URL(link).openConnection().connect() in a try/catch), which a package cannot do, so the check never passed and the script asked for the URL forever. Owner decision: a URL that starts with http counts as valid, which the script already wrote http after replacing https; any other answer is refused as before.
